app.name: FITD Wii Teste 02
app.short_description: Native Wii GX with original PAK backgrounds
app.long_description: Preliminary PowerPC/GX homebrew technical prototype for the classic Alone in the Dark engine. Displays original CAMERA00.PAK indexed backgrounds with ITD_RESS palette, and tests GX geometry, SD/FAT, big-endian archive reading and controllers. NOT a playable game. Original game files are not included.
